model_metadata.frame_sampling: uniform random priority per class, sorted utterance IDs

partition.manifest_hash_encoding: SHA256 of ID-sorted full-row JSON; sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII

calibration.rule: Clean BF ascending scores[n//20]; bonafide iff clean score >= threshold

clean_pilot.scope_note: Caller-supplied manifest; pilot/full label does not certify official benchmark completeness.

narrow_custom_stress.scope_note: Caller-supplied manifest; pilot/full label does not certify official benchmark completeness.

average_custom_stress.scope_note: Caller-supplied manifest; pilot/full label does not certify official benchmark completeness.

failure_cases.selection_rule: Analysis errors only. First ID in each delta-sign and top-quarter-disagreement stratum, deduplicate; fill to 10 by descending abs_delta then ID. Top quarters use ceil(N/4) of all analysis records, ties by ID.

limitations: Custom balanced dev pilot; full-dev EER/min t-DCF are exploratory, not official benchmark results.
Official dev ASV scores are held fixed; transformed CM diagnostics do not jointly transform the ASV system.
Analysis speakers are held apart from calibration but remain in the same dev domain and attack taxonomy.
Polyphase bandwidth reduction is not a real telephone channel or speech codec.
No learned fusion, analysis-label threshold tuning, significance test or novelty claim.
Illustrative failure examples are selected errors, not a representative random sample.
Process peak RSS includes imports; filesystem cache is uncontrolled; clean scores were reused.
